info.title: Conversion Tools Universal API
info.description: Convert files, documents, media, and structured data

post.description: Creates a new conversion task in Conversion Tools.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

type.description: Conversion type identifier from Conversion Tools, for example `convert.jpg_to_pdf` or `convert.xml_to_excel`.

options.description: Task options object. Include the required conversion inputs such as `file_id` or `url`, plus any conversion-specific settings. Set `sandbox` to `true` for a free provider-side test run.

callbackUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint that Conversion Tools should call when the task completes.

sandbox.description: Whether the task was created in sandbox mode.
